en: A colorized vintage postcard depicting a wooden railway station building with green-trimmed windows and a gabled roof beside train tracks. People stand on the platform in front. At the bottom, there is ornate handwritten text and printed captions in a Scandinavian language. The left caption reads "Lidköping" and the right one reads "Jernvägsstationen." The publisher credit and number appear in small print along the bottom edge.
